notes.title: Filmmaker Tycoon Update #02
notes.notes: For Update #02, we have now enabled Pause/Resume Functionality and fixed a few more bugs. We also did some performance optimizations.

notes.title: Filmmaker Tycoon Update #01
notes.notes:
For Update #01, we have added a bunch of new Steam Achievements. We have also tried to fix as many game breaking bugs as we could find. 

We have also decided to re-enable the Demo for Filmmaker Tycoon so people can try out the game before purchasing it.

notes.title: Filmmaker Tycoon Early Access Release Delayed to Nov 13, 2020
notes.notes:
Hey there future Filmmakers! We wanted you to be the first to know that we have decided to push Early Access Release by a week. The new release date is now on November 13, 2020. 

As you will soon find out in your Movies, the launch window is crucial to the success of the game. This extra week will give us a little more time to share the game to cultivate the best experience possible for you! After launch, this will also allow us to dedicate more resources to improving the game and implementing user suggestions for the main release! During this extra time we will be releasing fun videos and let's plays on YouTube. Be sure to check them out!

Thank you for understanding and supporting our team! Get those cameras ready...We'll see you on the 13th!

notes.title: Filmmaker Tycoon Early Access Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
The time has finally come! Filmmaker Tycoon is ready for Early Access Release. We are launching in Early Access on Nov 6, 2020. 

What's NEW?
During the demo, we wanted to show off a taste of Filmmaker Tycoon. A lot of features were disabled and we showed off a barebones version of the game. The Early Access release will have more features - Cameramen, Lighting Crew, Audio Crew, Disasters, Post Production, Marketing and more!

Studio Lot Decor
The success of your Movie Studio will depend on how well its maintained. You will be able to decorate your studio with trees, bushes, benches, vending machines, tiles and other amenities. The better your studio looks, the more attractive it will be for bigger stars to come work for you.

Movies, Movie Sets and Action!
Make movies across 14 different Movie Sets in a variety of different genres. You can mix and match actors, costumes, crew and more! Your every decision will reflect in the final movie, so choose wisely.

Wishlist Now
Wishlist the game now and we will see you on Nov 6, 2020!
